gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Stern, uniform strokes and a big-eyed lowercase: that's Unica One. Noto Sans Tirhuta follows with cut-back terminals and a dominant x-height, giving that commanding heading some open, easygoing company underneath.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-open-sans: Commanding from the first glance, Unica One draws each stroke at a single thickness with open, generous curves. And Open Sans, smooth and sturdy in the lowercase, lets that heading do its loudest work big and brief.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-orienta: Unica One has a huge-eyed lowercase and an unmodulated line. Orienta underneath is sans-serif, with breathing counters and little height difference between cases, a soft landing for that commanding heading.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-parkinsans: Unica One keeps its stroke width constant, with a huge-eyed lowercase and curves you can see straight through. Parkinsans echoes it, one thickness throughout and crisp even when shrunk.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-preahvihear: Unica One is all constant stroke, no tapering, with a huge-eyed lowercase. Preahvihear takes over for the reading, its oyster-open letter mouths and lofty x-height carrying paragraphs along smoothly.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-pt-sans-caption: Stout strokes from end to end, that's Unica One, tails and terminals included. PT Sans Caption, with its unclosed, inviting bowls and big-bodied lowercase, sits beneath it while the heading stays big and brief.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-radio-canada-big: Unica One strips every stroke to one constant width and gives the lowercase a huge eye. Radio Canada Big is monoline as well, its x-height filling the line, which makes the two feel related.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-readex-pro: Unica One has a huge-eyed lowercase and strokes that never swell or thin, which gives it real presence. And Readex Pro, with broad terminal gaps and steady weight, is happiest at modest sizes under a bigger heading.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-ruda: Stern and stripped back, Unica One holds every stroke to one width and leaves its curves open. Ruda, with its wire-like monoline skeleton and wide-mouthed rounds, reads well at modest sizes on screen, thanks to its sizable x-height.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-saira: Unica One looks stern: uniform strokes, big-eyed lowercase, no corner swelling. Saira follows with see-through s shapes and rounded letters stretching toward the top line, letting paragraphs move along clean and crisp.
